g.text: R1 | 3.3 V default, 5 V only after bench validation | 32 ohm load | 45 x 25 mm PCB

g.desc: R1 | 3.3 V default, 5 V only after bench validation | 32 ohm load | 45 x 25 mm PCB

g.text: 2 layers, FR4 1.6 mm; all components on top.

g.desc: 2 layers, FR4 1.6 mm; all components on top.

g.text: C1/C2: + to VREF/VDD. C3: next to U1 pin 8, short GND via.

g.desc: C1/C2: + to VREF/VDD. C3: next to U1 pin 8, short GND via.

g.text: U1 pin1 = OUTA; SO8 1.27 mm, not TSSOP.

g.desc: U1 pin1 = OUTA; SO8 1.27 mm, not TSSOP.

g.text: MODE LINKS: ATT fit R15/R16/R17/R18; leave R19/R20 DNP.

g.desc: MODE LINKS: ATT fit R15/R16/R17/R18; leave R19/R20 DNP.

g.text: DIRECT L: remove R15 AND R16, fit R19. DIRECT R: remove R17 AND R18, fit R20.

g.desc: DIRECT L: remove R15 AND R16, fit R19. DIRECT R: remove R17 AND R18, fit R20.

g.text: Two ATT links disconnect both ends of each divider in DIRECT. Never fit ATT and DIRECT together.

g.desc: Two ATT links disconnect both ends of each divider in DIRECT. Never fit ATT and DIRECT together.

g.text: Loaded ATT midband = -16.4 dB before 2.2R output. Active stage = -1. Input capacitors nonpolar.

g.text: C6/C7 positive terminals toward U1. No headphones on RAW outputs. Cable stability requires bench test.
